title: Pages of one series
description: Pages whose own properties are type: series and series: that page. Change the series name.

title: The same, on any series page
description: {{page}} is the page the query is on, so the block works unchanged on every series page.

title: As a table with the series in a column
query:
type: page
prop.type: [[series]]
prop.series: {{page}}
view: table
columns: page, prop.series

title: Journal entries of a series, with what is written under them
description: children: yes shows the sub-bullets under each entry.

title: Fewer property lines under the results
description: properties: none hides them all; properties: status, owner shows only those. Table columns are not affected.
query:
prop.type: [[series]]
prop.series: {{page}}
children: yes
properties: none

title: Open tasks of a client
query:
task: todo, doing
links: Client One

title: Tasks due in the next week, soonest first
query:
task: todo, doing
deadline: < +7d
sort: deadline asc

title: Tasks without a date
query:
task: todo
scheduled: none
deadline: none

title: A board of the tasks of a namespace
query:
task: todo, doing, done
ns: work/projects
view: kanban
group: task

title: Everything under a name that occurs in several places
description: path: matches the name anywhere in the page path.

title: Blocks that mention a word, ordered by page, the first 20
query:
text: invoice
sort: page asc
limit: 20

title: Pages of the same type as this one
Leave hidden pages out of a query
description: Add this line to any query.
